fullText.simplified:
第13章、考试

    鲁肃看完曹操写给孙权的信，对孙权说大家都可以投降，但孙权一定不能投降。
    孙权问：“我为什么不能投降？”
    鲁肃说：“看看荆州就知道了。荆州投降了，曹操让每个人都做了大官，只有一个人死了，那就是荆州之主刘从。如果江东也投降，大家也可以做大官，但曹操一定会杀了您。”
    孙权说：“是的，我真的不想再听大家说投降了，你的话才是我想听的。”
    鲁肃说：“您要不要听听刘备那边的想法？诸葛亮被我请来了。”
    “诸葛亮来了？他在哪儿？”
    “在城里的宾馆里，您想现在见他吗？”
    孙权想了想，说：“先请他见一见大家，让他听听大家的想法，然后我再见他。”
    鲁肃明白孙权的意思，孙权是想试一试诸葛亮。让诸葛亮这个聪明人去和那些想投降的助手们说说话，最后会有什么结果呢？
    鲁肃马上去请了诸葛亮。
    在孙权家的院子里，早就有十多个人等着诸葛亮了。
    这些人都是孙权的助手，有年轻人，也有老人，有的安静，有的一直在说话，他们是江东最会读书的人，也是江东最聪明的人。他们看上去都不一样，但他们有一个想法是一样的，那就是投降。他们问了诸葛亮很多问题，都很难，这是他们给诸葛亮的考试，但他们不是真的想听诸葛亮的回答，他们只是想告诉诸葛亮他们有多聪明。
    诸葛亮坐在他们中间，慢慢回答着他们的问题，他的声音有时候大，有时候小。不管那些助手们说什么话，也不管他们的话有多让人生气，诸葛亮好像都不会生气，有时候他还会笑一笑。后来，那些助手们生气了，他们的声音越来越大，样子也越来越气。最后，他们不说话了，他们没有话说了，但是他们的样子还是很生气。
fullText.traditional:
第13章、考試

    魯肅看完曹操寫給孫權的信，對孫權說大家都可以投降，但孫權一定不能投降。
    孫權問：“我為什麼不能投降？”
    魯肅說：“看看荊州就知道了。荊州投降了，曹操讓每個人都做了大官，只有一個人死了，那就是荊州之主劉從。如果江東也投降，大家也可以做大官，但曹操一定會殺了您。”
    孫權說：“是的，我真的不想再聽大家說投降了，你的話才是我想聽的。”
    魯肅說：“您要不要聽聽劉備那邊的想法？諸葛亮被我請來了。”
    “諸葛亮來了？他在哪兒？”
    “在城裡的賓館裡，您想現在見他嗎？”
    孫權想了想，說：“先請他見一見大家，讓他聽聽大家的想法，然後我再見他。”
    魯肅明白孫權的意思，孫權是想試一試諸葛亮。讓諸葛亮這個聰明人去和那些想投降的助手們說說話，最後會有什麼結果呢？
    魯肅馬上去請了諸葛亮。
    在孫權家的院子裡，早就有十多個人等著諸葛亮了。
    這些人都是孫權的助手，有年輕人，也有老人，有的安靜，有的一直在說話，他們是江東最會讀書的人，也是江東最聰明的人。他們看上去都不一樣，但他們有一個想法是一樣的，那就是投降。他們問了諸葛亮很多問題，都很難，這是他們給諸葛亮的考試，但他們不是真的想聽諸葛亮的回答，他們只是想告訴諸葛亮他們有多聰明。
    諸葛亮坐在他們中間，慢慢回答著他們的問題，他的聲音有時候大，有時候小。不管那些助手們說什麼話，也不管他們的話有多讓人生氣，諸葛亮好像都不會生氣，有時候他還會笑一笑。後來，那些助手們生氣了，他們的聲音越來越大，樣子也越來越氣。最後，他們不說話了，他們沒有話說了，但是他們的樣子還是很生氣。

sentences.english: Some were quiet, while others were constantly speaking.

sentences.traditional: 他們是江東最會讀書的人，也是江東最聰明的人。
sentences.pinyin: tā men shì jiāng dōng zuì huì dú shū de rén yě shì jiāng dōng zuì cōng ming de rén
sentences.english: They were Jiangdong’s best scholars and the most intelligent people in Jiangdong.

sentences.simplified: 他们看上去都不一样，但他们有一个想法是一样的，那就是投降。
sentences.traditional: 他們看上去都不一樣，但他們有一個想法是一樣的，那就是投降。
sentences.pinyin: tā men kàn shàng qù dōu bù yí yàng dàn tā men yǒu yí ge xiǎng fǎ shì yí yàng de nà jiù shì tóu xiáng
sentences.english: They all appeared to be very different, but they had one thought in common, which was to surrender.

sentences.simplified: 他们问了诸葛亮很多问题，都很难，这是他们给诸葛亮的考试，
sentences.traditional: 他們問了諸葛亮很多問題，都很難，這是他們給諸葛亮的考試，
sentences.pinyin: tā men wèn le zhū gě liàng hěn duō wèn tí dōu hěn nán zhè shì tā men gěi zhū gě liàng de kǎo shì
sentences.english: They asked Zhuge Liang many questions, all of them very difficult. They were testing Zhuge Liang.

sentences.simplified: 但他们不是真的想听诸葛亮的回答，他们只是想告诉诸葛亮他们有多聪明。
sentences.traditional: 但他們不是真的想聽諸葛亮的回答，他們只是想告訴諸葛亮他們有多聰明。
sentences.pinyin: dàn tā men bú shì zhēn de xiǎng tīng zhū gě liàng de huí dá tā men zhǐ shì xiǎng gào su zhū gě liàng tā men yǒu duō cōng ming
sentences.english: But they didn’t really want to hear Zhuge Liang’s response. They just wanted to tell Zhuge Liang how intelligent they were.

sentences.simplified: 诸葛亮坐在他们中间，慢慢回答着他们的问题，他的声音有时候大，有时候小。
sentences.traditional: 諸葛亮坐在他們中間，慢慢回答著他們的問題，他的聲音有時候大，有時候小。
sentences.pinyin: zhū gě liàng zuò zài tā men zhōng jiān màn man huí dá zhe tā men de wèn tí tā de shēng yīn yǒu shí hou dà yǒu shí hou xiǎo
sentences.english: Zhuge Liang sat between them and slowly answered their questions. His voice was sometimes loud, sometimes quiet.

sentences.simplified: 不管那些助手们说什么话，也不管他们的话有多让人生气，诸葛亮好像都不会生气，
sentences.traditional: 不管那些助手們說什麼話，也不管他們的話有多讓人生氣，諸葛亮好像都不會生氣，
sentences.pinyin: bù guǎn nà xiē zhù shǒu men shuō shén me huà yě bù guǎn tā men de huà yǒu duō ràng rén shēng qì zhū gě liàng hǎo xiàng dōu bú huì shēng qì
sentences.english: No matter what these assistants said, and regardless of how angry their words could make you, Zhuge Liang appeared not to get angry.

sentences.simplified: 有时候他还会笑一笑。
sentences.traditional: 有時候他還會笑一笑。
sentences.pinyin: yǒu shí hou tā hái huì xiào yí xiào
sentences.english: Sometimes, he even smiled.

sentences.simplified: 后来，那些助手们生气了，他们的声音越来越大，样子也越来越气。
sentences.traditional: 後來，那些助手們生氣了，他們的聲音越來越大，樣子也越來越氣。
sentences.pinyin: hòu lái nà xiē zhù shǒu men shēng qì le tā men de shēng yīn yuè lái yuè dà yàng zi yě yuè lái yuè qì
sentences.english: Afterward, these assistants all became angry. Their voices grew louder and louder, and they looked more and more angry.

sentences.simplified: 最后，他们不说话了，他们没有话说了，但是他们的样子还是很生气。
sentences.traditional: 最後，他們不說話了，他們沒有話說了，但是他們的樣子還是很生氣。
sentences.pinyin: zuì hòu tā men bù shuō huà le tā men méi yǒu huà shuō le dàn shì tā men de yàng zi hái shi hěn shēng qì
sentences.english: In the end, they stopped speaking. They had no words left to say, but they still looked very angry.

sentence_translations: Chapter 13: Test
Lu Su finished reading Cao Cao’s letter to Sun Quan.
He said to Sun Quan that everyone could surrender, but Sun Quan must not surrender.
Sun Quan asked, “Why can’t I surrender?”
Lu Su said, “Just look at Jingzhou, and you will know. When Jingzhou surrendered, Cao Cao made everyone into important officials.
Only one person died, and that was the master of Jingzhou, Liu Cong.
If Jiangdong also surrenders, everyone will be able to become an important official, but Cao Cao will certainly kill you.”
Sun Quan said, “Yes, I really don’t want to listen to everyone telling me to surrender anymore.
Your words are what I really want to hear.”
Lu Su said, “Do you want to hear what Liu Bei thinks? Zhuge Liang has come on my invitation.”
“Zhuge Liang has come? Where is he?”
“In a guesthouse in the city. Do you want to see him now?”
Sun Quan thought about it and said, “First, let him see everyone, let him hear what everyone thinks. Then I will see him.”
Lu Su understood what Sun Quan was saying. Sun Quan wanted to test Zhuge Liang.
He was making the intelligent Zhuge Liang talk with those assistants who wanted to surrender. What would the final outcome be?
Lu Su immediately went to invite Zhuge Liang.
In the courtyard of Sun Quan’s home, there were already 10 or so people waiting for Zhuge Liang.
These people were all Sun Quan’s assistants. There were young people as well as old people.
Some were quiet, while others were constantly speaking.
They were Jiangdong’s best scholars and the most intelligent people in Jiangdong.
They all appeared to be very different, but they had one thought in common, which was to surrender.
They asked Zhuge Liang many questions, all of them very difficult. They were testing Zhuge Liang.
But they didn’t really want to hear Zhuge Liang’s response. They just wanted to tell Zhuge Liang how intelligent they were.
Zhuge Liang sat between them and slowly answered their questions. His voice was sometimes loud, sometimes quiet.
No matter what these assistants said, and regardless of how angry their words could make you, Zhuge Liang appeared not to get angry.
Sometimes, he even smiled.
Afterward, these assistants all became angry. Their voices grew louder and louder, and they looked more and more angry.
In the end, they stopped speaking. They had no words left to say, but they still looked very angry.
